snippet.title: EverQuest Legends Pre-Orders Open!
snippet.description: We are thrilled to announce that Pre-Orders are now open for EverQuest Legends! Join us on a brand new adventure in Norrath. Pre-Order includes Name Reservation, the in-game title "the Legend," and access to Pre-Order Beta on July 1, 2026! #everquestlegends https://www.everquestlegends.com/shop
